art_direction: Exaggerated semi-realistic young adult virtual host with a bright orange asymmetrical hair streak and oversize deep-teal utility jacket, paired with tiny floating round blue robot Patch with one glowing eye and expressive eyebrows. Two original cartoon-like characters, never a copy of a known animation franchise.
personality: Pip is fearless curious human-like host
Argument turns into a practical takeaway
voice: Pip expressive humanlike original synthetic voice; Patch distinct pitched ORIGINAL processed robot voice; no celebrity imitation.
quirk: Patch carries a floating red 'NOPE' rubber stamp and interrupts exaggerated AI promises every time.
audience: Young creators and practical tech beginners
monetization: Sponsored original animation segments, clearly disclosed
Transparent affiliate links to independently tested tools

pilot.title: Patch Fixes a Terrible Prompt
pilot.hook: I ASKED AI FOR A BUSINESS.
pilot.sample_script: Pip: I asked an AI for a business idea. Patch: You gave it three words. Pip: And it gave me a space laundromat. Patch: Try a budget, audience and problem. Pip: Oh. A real answer. Patch: Shocking.

shots.visual: Original orange-streak avatar throws up a blank prompt bubble
Robot zooms in to a three-word comic prompt
Absurd custom vector space laundromat spins with sock satellites
Patch stamps a bright NOPE over the joke
Three original UI chips: Budget, Audience, Problem
Pip and Patch face camera, easy comedic final beat
